rows.question: Why use this instead of ChatGPT or Jev?
rows.evidence: Baseline-first guidance; no universal superiority promise.

rows.question: What did Mark build, and what came from elsewhere?
rows.evidence: Prepared specification downloadable; THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES retained; provenance stated in spoken guide.

rows.question: Why use AI for a price check?
rows.evidence: Budget stays arithmetic; actual API example returned model policy reason separately.

rows.question: Are fixed answers always correct or deterministic?
rows.evidence: Three-choice interaction; uncalibrated probability and no determinism guarantee disclosed.

rows.question: Is fine-tuning the same as writing a prompt?
rows.evidence: Training vs normal request diagram; runtime/layout/contrast checks at 0, 9, 18 seconds passed.

rows.question: Do I have to train before trying the demo?
rows.evidence: Fresh uv sync --frozen; prerequisite checker passed; existing saved weights selected.

rows.question: Where did the examples come from?
rows.evidence: Actual training and held-out record downloads with source hashes; synthetic/reference repair limits spoken.

rows.question: How many examples should I use?
rows.evidence: 20-case smoke test explicitly not a training minimum; split leakage guidance in adaptation doc.

rows.question: How do I adapt the support example?
rows.evidence: Editor add/reset verified; converter maps labels to candidate index; invalid/duplicate data tests passed.

rows.question: What did the benchmark compare?
rows.evidence: Frozen 360-case/1440-decision comparison; V2 95.28 vs Jev 98.61; loss and text-only scope shown.

rows.question: Why does the live app use V1?
rows.evidence: Active V1 and later V2 separated; historical different-corpus 66.5 is not a same-test gain.

rows.question: How do I know a test was fair?
rows.evidence: Actual failed 01:30 case with full-input downloadable receipt.

rows.question: Does this make pictures or read them?
rows.evidence: Local photo endpoint runs on supplied pixels; stairs and pond fresh receipts; nine fictional shared images disclosed.

rows.question: Can hosted Jev recognize images?
rows.evidence: Explicit distinction: local demonstration does not establish current hosted Jev image support.

rows.question: Do my photo files leave my computer?
rows.evidence: Fixed loopback endpoint and no filename upload verified by regression test; browser native file-picker verified.

rows.question: What can I conclude from a photograph?
rows.evidence: Pond boundary reveal and access/price/safety limits in guide.

rows.question: What does a green card mean?
rows.evidence: Rules diagram and decline/review distinction; no booking or autonomous approval.

rows.question: Does it replace a general assistant?
rows.evidence: Narrow task scope and unsupported phone/always-on/helpdesk promises removed.

rows.question: Does it work on Windows, Linux or my phone?
rows.evidence: Tested host clearly separated from minimum requirements; Windows/Linux and small-memory unvalidated.

rows.question: What does it cost?
rows.evidence: Build and run costs separated; total build bill and universal price ratio not measured.

rows.question: How fast is it?
rows.evidence: Cold request, warm HTTP and forty-offer photo run visibly separated by workload.

rows.question: What happens after sleep or a failure?
rows.evidence: Live status checker verified; restart instructions and no fake answer on outage regression test.

rows.question: Can I download, modify or sell this?
rows.evidence: Private source kit and release prepared. Public access and original-code license need Mark’s decision.

rows.question: How do I connect the decision to another app?
rows.evidence: Actual API example executed successfully: match plus budget/policy reasons. Support adapter limits explicit.

rows.question: Keep the explanation concrete and conversational
rows.evidence: Published-transcript voice fingerprint; no-ai-slop pass; 1,512 spoken words with concrete travel nouns and short conclusions.

rows.question: Preserve persona look and readable filming surfaces
rows.evidence: Pixel Maya, sage/forest palette and rounded cards retained. All 18 scenes captured at 1440×900, 1920×1080, 1366×768 and 390×844; no horizontal overflow.

rows.question: Keep guide, diagrams and narration synchronized
rows.evidence: 20-page PDF rendered and visually inspected. 18 scenes / 1,512 words / 12:10. Production check: 16 pass, 0 warning, 0 error.
